candidates.structural_interaction: Metal directing Wood cross-polarity — precision shaping reach toward structured outcomes
candidates.k2_overview: Your Wood moves as the Steward: growth banked in rings. You build worth the way orchards do, planted early, tended patiently, harvested honestly, replanted always. Assets in your care grow. So do people. Your fortune is cumulative and alive, and it rewards the seasons you refuse to rush.
candidates.k2_functional: You build annually: steady deposits of effort that quietly become an estate.

k2_domain_readings.Wealth: Your wealth is orchard-shaped: productive assets, patient growth, income in seasons. Buy things that grow, land, skills, dividends, and let time do the heaviest lifting. It intends to.
k2_domain_readings.Savings: You save like a granary: harvests stored against winters. Rotate the stock, reinvest the surplus, and remember granaries exist so that planting can be brave.
k2_domain_readings.Steady love: You love agriculturally: devotion planted deep, tended daily, expected to fruit for decades. Choose a fellow gardener. Then keep courting through every season, even the mud ones.
